## Vocabulary

Terms this pack was harvested with, grouped by their relation to the concept; counts are units matched / sources. Zero-hit terms are listed under Coverage. On every unit line, `keywords:` names the terms that matched.

- **self**: per-accumulator explain memory statistics (16/3)

## Definitions

- [statement] Each entry is a peak tracked byte count for an accumulation statement across groups, not the maximum size of one group's accumulator. MongoDB 8.0 creates one tracker per output field and adds each group's accumulator memory and subsequent changes to that tracker. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/document_source_group_base.cpp · keywords: per-accumulator explain memory statistics · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/group_processor_base.cpp
- [statement] The per-field map is not a complete stage-memory measurement. MongoDB 8.0 separately adds each new group key's approximate size to the overall tracker; the serializer exports only the accumulation-statement trackers. Consequently, an empty accumulator map does not establish that grouping used no memory. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/document_source_group_base.cpp · keywords: per-accumulator explain memory statistics · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/group_processor_base.cpp

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] To evaluate a pipeline change, collect explain("executionStats") on representative input before and after the change, and compare accumulator memory with execution time and spill activity. Platzi teaches this before/after measurement workflow; MongoDB's serializer confirms that the accumulator measurements require execution-statistics verbosity. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/document_source_group_base.cpp · keywords: per-accumulator explain memory statistics · also: https://platzi.com/cursos/mongodb-aggregation/como-medir-el-rendimiento-de-un-pipeline/

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Per-field peaks are not a measurement of total stage memory or process RSS. In MongoDB 8.0, group-key size is added separately to the overall tracker. Inference: summing accumulator field peaks cannot recover the exact peak of the whole stage, because keys are omitted and field peaks can occur at different times. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/group_processor_base.cpp · keywords: per-accumulator explain memory statistics · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/document_source_group_base.cpp

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] In the classic $group explain output, maxAccumulatorMemoryUsageBytes is an object keyed by accumulator output field name. Each value is that field's tracked peak memory in bytes, rather than a configured memory limit. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/document_source_group_base.cpp · keywords: per-accumulator explain memory statistics · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/exec/agg/group_base_stage.cpp, https://stackoverflow.com/questions/77758994/how-to-speed-up-the-mongo-aggregation-over-milion-documents
- [statement] maxAccumulatorMemoryUsageBytes reports observed usage rather than a configured cap. In the inspected MongoDB 8.0 code, the group processor receives a maximum-memory setting separately, while explain exports the per-field maximum-memory measurements. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/document_source_group_base.cpp · keywords: per-accumulator explain memory statistics · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/group_processor_base.cpp

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The MongoDB 8.0 group serializer emits these memory and spill statistics only at executionStats verbosity or higher. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/document_source_group_base.cpp · keywords: per-accumulator explain memory statistics · also: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/77758994/how-to-speed-up-the-mongo-aggregation-over-milion-documents
- [statement] Read maxAccumulatorMemoryUsageBytes alongside usedDisk and spills; memory accounting and disk use are separate measurements. A published MongoDB 7.0.2 explain reports unitsSold at 2,392,000 bytes with usedDisk:false and spills:0. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/document_source_group_base.cpp · keywords: per-accumulator explain memory statistics · also: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/77758994/how-to-speed-up-the-mongo-aggregation-over-milion-documents
- [statement] MongoDB 8.3 documents peakTrackedMemBytes for the query and for blocking stages. This has a different scope from the per-output-field accumulator object. The current master group serializer still emits that accumulator object using per-field peakTrackedMemoryBytes calls. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: per-accumulator explain memory statistics · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/exec/agg/group_base_stage.cpp
- [statement] Explain layout depends on optimization and execution engine: the documented SBE pushdown example places GROUP inside the cursor query plan, and a fully optimized pipeline can omit stages entirely. Inspect the actual winning/execution plan before assuming a classic $group stage object will exist. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: per-accumulator explain memory statistics
- [statement] A useful diagnostic method is to record explain memory, timing and disk-use values, change one pipeline feature, and rerun the comparison. Platzi demonstrates this workflow with earlier filtering; MongoDB's serializer and a user-posted explain show the concrete accumulator-memory and spill fields available for such comparisons. (medium confidence) — https://platzi.com/cursos/mongodb-aggregation/como-medir-el-rendimiento-de-un-pipeline/ · keywords: per-accumulator explain memory statistics · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/document_source_group_base.cpp, https://stackoverflow.com/questions/77758994/how-to-speed-up-the-mongo-aggregation-over-milion-documents
- [statement] An independent ride-booking project publishes a facet explain containing separate avgRating and totalReviews accumulator entries and a distinct stage peakTrackedMemBytes. Treat this as an illustrative user artifact, not a controlled benchmark or proof of version-wide behavior. (low confidence) — https://github.com/amaan070/Ride_Booking_21 · keywords: per-accumulator explain memory statistics
- [statement] In MongoDB 8.0's DocumentSourceGroupBase path, explain with executionStats verbosity or higher emits maxAccumulatorMemoryUsageBytes keyed by accumulator output field name. A firsthand count-query example shows the entry n for the accumulator n: {$sum: 1}. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/document_source_group_base.cpp · keywords: per-accumulator explain memory statistics · also: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/75614580/count-documents-in-java-mongodb-driver-only-without-fetch-phase
- [statement] Distinguish accumulator memory, output size and spills: MongoDB 8.0 serializes totalOutputDataSizeBytes separately and derives usedDisk from whether spills is greater than zero. The posted count example reports n memory of 80 bytes, output size of 237 bytes, usedDisk false and spills zero; those values describe that execution, not universal accumulator sizes. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/document_source_group_base.cpp · keywords: per-accumulator explain memory statistics · also: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/75614580/count-documents-in-java-mongodb-driver-only-without-fetch-phase
- [statement] Do not require one fixed explain layout across server versions and execution engines. MongoDB documents that fields can change and engine-specific structures differ. The inspected 8.0 serializer uses numBytesSpilledEstimate, whereas the development-source snapshot uses spilledBytes and conditionally adds peakTrackedMemBytes. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/document_source_group_base.cpp · keywords: per-accumulator explain memory statistics · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/exec/agg/group_base_stage.cpp, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/explain-results/
- [statement] MongoDB documents db.collection.explain().aggregate() for aggregate explain output, and executionStats as a supported explain verbosity mode. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.explain.md · keywords: per-accumulator explain memory statistics · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/pipeline/document_source_group_base.cpp, https://stackoverflow.com/questions/77758994/how-to-speed-up-the-mongo-aggregation-over-milion-documents
